component.name: WayVoice
component.summary: Local voice dictation for GNOME and Wayland
Локальный голосовой ввод для GNOME и Wayland

description.p: WayVoice records microphone audio through PipeWire, transcribes it locally and inserts the result into the focused application.
WayVoice записывает микрофон через PipeWire, локально распознаёт речь и вставляет результат в активное приложение.

Automatic pasting now works on distributions that do not package ydotool: the helper is built from vendored sources and shipped with the package. A distribution's own copy is always preferred. Licence is AGPL-3.0-or-later, and the release is published by pushing a tag.

Model management with a visible, cancellable download, all 100 recognition languages, an engine registry, a warm worker that loads the model when the daemon starts, and a daemon that starts with or without systemd.
License metadata aligned to GPL-3.0-only across the About dialog, packaging metadata and AppStream data.
Localization, safer transcription, GNOME-style icon, diagnostics and GitHub project infrastructure.
